The previous mention of a "urinary tract infection" does not explain severe night pain or knee swelling, so I must rely on your joint symptoms. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Giant Cell Tumor of Bone.

The X-ray finding of a lytic lesion with a "soap bubble" appearance in the distal femur of a 24-year-old is classic for this diagnosis. The normal CBC with slightly elevated ESR confirms it is primarily local and not a systemic infection like the UTR previously suggested. I will not order further tests at this time.
